title: Locale file with verified emergency number + protocol note (1 region)
context: The same language deploys to different locales, so each pack injects locale data: the verified emergency number and a region-specific protocol note. A wrong or outdated emergency number is treated as a safety defect, so locale data must be verified against an official source with a date. This task produces the first verified locale file.
objective: Produce one locale file with an emergency number and protocol note verified against an official source.
acceptanceCriteria: locales/<region>.yaml contains region, emergencyNumber, protocolNotes, verifiedBy, verifiedDate
Emergency number and protocol note are verified against an official source, with the source and verification date recorded
Validates against localeSchema and passes CI structural checks
Structured so the source/locale-change watcher can re-verify it later
